title: docs(skills): mark the always-on tokens in the platform skill's requires: table

_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xVLaZCHfVovNCieVsJ1xWP3)_

Fixes #31130

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a MANDATORY model tier for `skills/**` (clause ① of the model-tiering ruling); it is waived by the standing order of the maintainer in this project (2026-11-03), and this card ran on the project's default model. The dispatching seat runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-platform` 的 `### requires:` 表用 ° 标出全部常驻 token（`PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES`），导语改为「标 ° 的每次启动都挂载，列不列都一样；`--preset minimal` 恰好去掉这些」；`auth`→`email` 规则注明 minimal 下也成立，`triggers`+`job` 配对限定到 `--preset minimal`；`queues`/`assignmentRules` 一段删去「(`sharing` in `requires`)」；eval 第 3、9 例不再要求在 `requires` 里写 `job`/`messaging`/`sharing`，新增第 20 例（常驻服务要不要列进 `requires:`）。
- 为什么改：导语原文「其余服务插件都是 opt-in」与代码相反：`resolveServedCapabilities` 在非 minimal 预设下把常驻清单追加到每个应用的 `requires`（#31130）。作者会误以为未列出的服务不存在。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文字与 eval；SKILL.md 6007 → 6004 / 6011（净减 3 token），无上限上调；发 `@objectstack/skills` patch；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` § `### requires:` 的导语和表，以及 L55 的 `sharing` 一句（下方 diff）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期退出 0，`objectstack-platform/SKILL.md 6004 / 6011`。
- 需要你做的：`skills/**` 属 Tier H（人合），需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 的一次 approval，之后席位落地。

## Code sites read (on `main` `8ef4d309`, re-checked after merging `21c1f748`)

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts` `PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES`: `queue`, `job`, `cache`, `settings`, `email`, `storage`, `sms`, `sharing`, `messaging`, `analytics`, `package-registry`. These, and only these, carry ° in the table.
- `packages/core/src/capability-composition.ts` `resolveServedCapabilities`, in order: the declared tokens (deduplicated); `email` when `auth` is declared; `hostDefaults`; the slate unless `preset === 'minimal'`; then `job` and `queue` moved to the front when `email` / `approvals` / `auth` is present. So `--preset minimal` drops the slate and nothing else.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` L3006–3009: `hostDefaults` = `mcp` unless `OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED` is `0`/`false`/`off`/`no` (`packages/types/src/env.ts` `isMcpServerEnabled`), plus `pinyin-search` when `stampSearchPinyinEnabled(config.i18n)` (the env var, else any `zh-*` locale). They are appended under every preset, `minimal` included. Not taught here (see Other sites).
- `packages/core/src/capability-providers.ts`: every slate token has a provider row (`package-registry` → `@objectstack/service-package`, L174), and `packages/cli/package.json` depends on all eleven provider packages, so a stock `os serve` mounts each one.

Every existing table row was checked against `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` and core's `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS`: every service token has a row and every row names its registry package. No phantom row, no missing row.

## Token readings and the deletions that pay them

`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (`ceil((bytes − 20) / 4)`): `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` **6007 / 6011 on `main`** (24045 bytes) → **6004 / 6011 at this head** (24035 bytes): a net change of −3 tokens. No ceiling raised; `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is untouched; standing ruling 6513306068 is not used.

The growth (lead sentence + eleven ° markers) is paid by the deletions below, all in the same file. Facts each cut text held, and where each survives:

| Cut | Facts it held | Surviving home |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Tier-gated bullet: ", the other three through their tier blocks" | `i18n` / `ui` / `auth` open a tier | Same bullet: "dedicated blocks in `serve.ts` `run()` open their tier instead", which names all five tokens |
| `auth` bullet: "so the CLI appends `email` whenever `auth` is required" | the CLI appends `email` when `auth` is declared | The bullet's own head "`auth` implies `email`", which now also says it holds under `--preset minimal` |
| `automation` bullet: "they have nowhere to register and" | connector executors register with the automation service | Same sentence: "connector executors register their provider factories with it" |
| `triggers` bullet: "autolaunched", "without `job`" | scheduled flows are autolaunched; they need `job` | The bullet's head now names the pairing ("pair `triggers` with `job`"); "scheduled flows" stays |
| Lead: "and … is what" | none (wording) | n/a |
| § Full Configuration Reference L55–56: " (`sharing` in `requires`)" (contract review M1) | the ownership-queue service comes from the `sharing` token | The `### requires:` table (`sharing`° → `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, always-on) and its lead (`--preset minimal` drops it). The remaining sentence ("Both need the ownership-queue service `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` registers: a stack declaring either without it is refused at boot") is true under every preset. |

No deleted text is pinned: `grep` of `scripts/**` and `packages/**` for each cut phrase finds only files that never read this skill ("nowhere to register" is matched in `create-objectstack`'s starter-comment test, which reads the scaffold's own comments, and the test's regex also accepts "boot fails", which stays).

## Eval cases (`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json`)

- **Case 3 corrected** (seat ruling Q1). It expected `requires: ['automation', 'triggers', 'job', 'messaging']` and said notify is skipped without `messaging`. Both are always-on on a default boot. It now expects `requires: ['automation', 'triggers']`, says `job` and `messaging` are always-on, and gives the `--preset minimal` caveat. `must_contain` drops `job` / `messaging` for `--preset minimal`. No new `must_not_contain` entry: a careful answer writes the minimal-preset line as `requires: ['automation', 'triggers', 'job', 'messaging']` (contract review S1).
- **Case 9 corrected** (contract review M1; claim widened in 6709825690). It expected "plus `'sharing'` in `requires` … else the boot is refused". The refusal (`describeMissingOwnershipQueueService`, `packages/objectql/src/assignment-rules.ts`) tests only that the `ownership-queue` service is registered, and `sharing` is always-on. It now says no `requires` change is needed on a default boot and gives the `--preset minimal` caveat; `must_contain` takes `sharing` instead of `'sharing'` and adds `--preset minimal`, as cases 3 and 20 have, so the old unconditional answer no longer passes (delta review should-fix); `'sharing'` is not banned, since the minimal-preset line spells it.
- **Case 20 added**: "Do I have to list `storage` and `settings` in `requires:`?" Expected: no, both are always-on, listing is harmless, only `--preset minimal` drops them. `must_contain` is `--preset minimal` only; neither case 3 nor case 20 requires the hyphenated "always-on" (contract review N2). Eval fixtures are measured, not ratcheted.

## Interplay

#31115 item 2 (open, unclaimed) would register this table as a liveness-exhaustive section against `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` ∩ `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS`. The ° marker sits outside the backticks, so the token spans it would parse are unchanged; whichever of the two lands second re-reads the first.

## Other sites found (reported, not fixed)

Filed as #31184 by the seat: it covers items 1–3 below (the automation rows, the host defaults and the jsdoc).

1. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` § Prerequisite table: the `job`, `queue` and `messaging` rows give an "Absent ⇒" outcome, but all three are always-on, so those outcomes happen only under `--preset minimal`. Even there, `email`, `approvals` or `auth` pulls `job` and `queue` back in (`NEEDS_JOB_AND_QUEUE`, `packages/core/src/capability-composition.ts`). Same teaching in `references/examples-flows.md` L132 and `references/integration-recipes.md` L62 (`'job'` added to `requires`).
2. The lead's "Every other service plugin is opt-in" is still false for `mcp` and `pinyin-search`: `os serve` adds `mcp` (unless `OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED` is off) and `pinyin-search` (for a `zh-*` locale) as host defaults under every preset, `minimal` included. Left out: the clause naming both costs more than the 7 tokens the `sharing` deletion freed.
3. `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts`, the jsdoc on `'package-registry'` in `PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES` ("⚠️ SCOPE … inert under `objectstack serve` … that registry keys `marketplace`, not this token") is stale: `packages/core/src/capability-providers.ts` L174 keys `package-registry` now.
